Assign/reorder/unsection/remove against stale revision returns conflict; two concurrent clients cannot silently overwrite.

One State atomic boundary contains project+operation+event; interrupted commit preserves previous valid state/recoverable draft; unknown schema rejected; native/web use same canonical representation.
Current installed native/web/source/PDB and real hosted provider acceptance remain separate from source review and fake fixtures.
